# AI Alchemy

> AI Alchemy is a technology consulting and implementation firm based in the Greater Toronto Area. We modernize systems, connect your software, and put AI to work, so your people spend less time on manual tasks and more on what matters.

Five connected capabilities: systems modernization, systems integration, workflow automation, data and reporting, and generative AI enablement. Clients can start with the one they need. Our team is based in the GTA and does the work itself.

How we work, in three steps: understand the people, systems and bottlenecks; design the right solution; build, test and support adoption.

To start a project, send a short project brief. It takes three steps. Your brief opens as an email you send. We reply within one business day. Email: hello@ai-alchemy.ca

## Capabilities

- [Capabilities overview](https://ai-alchemy.ca/services/): All five capabilities in one place.
- [Systems Modernization](https://ai-alchemy.ca/services/systems-modernization/): Build a stronger foundation. Upgrade legacy technology and build software around how your people work.
- [Systems Integration](https://ai-alchemy.ca/services/systems-integration/): Get your systems working together. Connect your applications so information flows across your business.
- [Workflow Automation](https://ai-alchemy.ca/services/workflow-automation/): Spend less time on manual work. Reduce repetitive tasks and simplify handoffs between teams.
- [Data & Reporting](https://ai-alchemy.ca/services/data-reporting/): See clearly. Make informed decisions. Bring your information together for a clearer view of your business.
- [Generative AI Enablement](https://ai-alchemy.ca/services/generative-ai-enablement/): Put business knowledge to work. Identify practical uses, connect AI to business knowledge, and equip your team to use it confidently.
- [How we work](https://ai-alchemy.ca/how-we-work/): Understand your business. Build what moves it forward.

## Industries

- [Industries overview](https://ai-alchemy.ca/industries/): The industries we work with, and the problems we fix in each.
- [Manufacturing, Wholesale & Logistics](https://ai-alchemy.ca/industries/manufacturing-wholesale-logistics/): Production, inventory, orders and operations. For fabricators, distributors and logistics teams. Connect sales, inventory, the shop floor and freight in one system. Send customers milestone updates.
- [Mortgage & Insurance](https://ai-alchemy.ca/industries/mortgage-insurance/): Information flow, documents and workflows, with review and accountability intact. Bring intake, documents, renewals and claims tracking into one place. Send status updates at each milestone.
- [HVAC, Energy & Home Improvement](https://ai-alchemy.ca/industries/hvac-energy-home-improvement/): Field operations, customer records, scheduling and admin, connected. Connect dispatch, field estimates and maintenance schedules. Link service records to client accounts and billing.
- [Financial, Professional Services & Non-Profits](https://ai-alchemy.ca/industries/financial-professional-services-non-profits/): Internal systems, records, reporting and coordination. Keep each client’s or donor’s information in one place. Track onboarding, communication and deadlines beside it.
